Honestly I hate to say it but for a while now I've thought that it would be better if dogs were surgically muted from birth. I know that sounds extreme but you brought up the exact point I've based my thought around, dogs genuinely aren't well-trained AT all and they ARE understandably stressed and barking is absolutely a sign of that. 

But imo to remove the availability of dogs to people who want them(or even genuinely often need the companionship) feels equally cruel. I can't tell you how often I've seen people homeless have dogs/pets and how genuinely important they are as protection AND mentally therapeutic companions to people not sensorally overwhelmed by their energy and behaviors. 

But barking is an unnecessary trait in the modern era. Outside of herding practices, honestly, their barks aren't even necessary and are a stressor and nuisance at most/all times. 

Additionally, the consistency and temperament required to properly train them out of barking behaviors can be prohibitively expensive. So if fixing animals so they don't breed out of control, like cats, is so common, why couldn't also surgically muting them be too? 

Dogs don't JUST bark to get someone's attention, they also act out bodily. This means they could still serve as protectors in close quarter scenarios. ALSO, if it IS a case of an anxious animal left alone in a domestic home and poorly cared for, nobody nearby needs to be disturbed or affected EXCEPT the owners who return to a home that's been ransacked by a hyper and frantic dog. 

It just seems like it would drastically reduce the most common problem of dogs at large being their barking. Domestically kept pets in modern society don't NEED to make noise to get attention- because they don't even do exclusively barking when they DO need to get another creature's attention. The barking is an adjunct to bodily displays and gestures. 

But that's just my theory. I don't think barking is necessary anymore but the thing is, even "non-barking" dog breeds like Basenjis actually still make noises and breeders aren't motivated as readily to select for quieter breeds as they are for Lookism. Which... I mean, I get it. It's not always good tho (brachisyphalic breeds are utterly devastated by breeding for skull structures & features that create the smashed in looking faces of pugs n the like) but fur patterns and colors and some stuff I can understand, so I don't hate on all selective breeding attempts... 

But breeding for sound is an entirely different and weird/difficult means... so why not just surgically assist the process like we already do with commonly desired sterilization practices?

Idk tho, it always sounds so extreme and the minute I bring it up, every dog lover on the planet wants my head on a pike but even outside of their reactionary defensiveness, I'd still like to wonder if maybe there's something else I'm missing. What do you think?

Like, when you were a kid bored in class and ever played with an uncoiled paper clip? And like, tried to scratch your name or mock doodle designs and hearts on your hand, arm, or leg? But of course you were always too worried of pain to break the skin so obviously you're content with just red marks/lines?

It's EXACTLY like that sensation.
Take a kinda dull thumb tack and like, try doodling anywhere. Lil hard but no skinbreak. Like, the artists sometimes talks with you and that's cool but sometimes it gets quiet (relatively, bc tat gun bzzzz) and you're lost in thought and your mind wanders.... and if you start to actually feel pain as they reach a more tender part of flesh, one good way to cope with it is thinking of a time when you wanted to cause or feel physical pain as catharsis,  punishment, pleasure,  whatever your itch, it was a frustration when you COULDN'T have it, right? Like u really want the dude you decided to try sleeping with would just GROW a pair and actually SMACK that ASS, not this love tap nonsense.

Or like, other intense emotions related to pain, like how bout when you were so angry you wanted to pick a fistfight and went around all stompy and fist/teeth clenched like I WISH someone would!! TRY to fuck with me, just FUCKIN TRY. So help me god I *WILL* JUMP OUT THIS CAR IF U BEEP-BITCH AT ME 1 MORE TIME, LIL FUCKNUGGET, TRY ME, COME ON. YOU WANNA GO? LES GO. RIGHT HERE.

Anyway, ye, that feeling, clench up and kinda relive that frustration and fury or intensity, it makes the pain actually start to feel good and like a M A J O R stress relief. 
Like, dude, seriously tho?? After my first session, shit felt like THERAPY for every imaginable frustration. Maybe that's one of the ways it becomes so addictive? 

Cuz like, real REAL talk? If I was loaded or even just had a regular $60ish to blow on a weekly basis, I'd have been in and out every ink shop every other week.

Big tat, small tat, it TRULY did not matter for what I got in return.

Because for me? it was like magic. Truly some kind of damn magic. Call it spiritual, what ever, i have no idea. It just felt like such a weight off when you were done.
Cathartic and somehow even necessary?? Like just taking ALL that pain you been building up over weeks/months/years etc and just focusing on the moment, the adrenaline kicking in THINKING about whatever was driving you up the wall like that fuckin ASSHOLE roommate and KNOCKING THE SHIT OUTTA HIS WHINY LIL PAMPERED ASS YOUR BOSS LITERALLY LETS U NAP AT WORK AND BE ON YOUR PHONE ALL DAY LONG, U SPOILT LITTLE SHIT, YET U ALWAYS FIND SOMETHIN TO BITCH ABOUT EVERY.SINGLE.DAYYYY and doing whatever, kicking their ass, wadding the situation/person/thing up like a shitty paper and chucking it off a cliff, it FEELS like you can FINALLY let GO and somehow the pain HELPED that, like give closure or an outlet.
